title: Read-only MCP tools: spares by category and recent crashes
goal: NERV can answer "spare motors left" and show recent crashes
acceptance: A read-only tool returns spares for a category (or all) with new and used counts per component model and the category totals, so "spare motors left" is one call
A read-only tool returns recent crashes (newest first, a bounded count, optional drone filter) with drone, part, damage and spare used
Specs with invented data; the tool table lists them
privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner
A surface type or page bricks lacks goes to bricks as a proposal, never a local copy in NERV

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-25: two tools on the server from F-011-T01. Not a measurement.
